literal_contract: For every positive-definite Sigma and every stated balanced initialization with 0<alpha<sqrt(2)/(d^(1/4)||Sigma||_op), for every epsilon>0 there is L(epsilon) such that every L>=L(epsilon) has limiting finite-softmax gradient-flow risk at most the Bayes risk plus epsilon.
acceptance: Derive the exact infinite-prompt population risk and gradient-flow equations.
Prove convergence from the full published initialization domain without relying on the narrower cited JMLR sufficient condition.
Prove the only attainable limit is the advertised zero-risk Bayes endpoint.
Track arbitrary finite covariance scale through the finite/infinite transfer estimates.
Reject a control that violates balanced initialization.
Exit nonzero if any proof obligation is absent or altered.
